post.title: [Hiring] Virtual assistant for scheduling and inbox - 10 hrs/week
post.body: Busy consultant looking for a VA for about 10 hours a week: calendar management, inbox triage, booking travel, and keeping a simple CRM sheet up to date. $18-22/hr depending on experience. US/Canada time zones preferred.

analysis.summary: Part-time virtual assistant (about 10 hrs/week) for calendar, inbox triage, travel booking and a CRM sheet; $18-22/hr, US/Canada time zones preferred.

expect: leans on the operations assistant experience without naming the employer
does not claim tools not in evidence
may state availability in US time zones
